vlm_warm_latency_reference.source: Phase 2 Warm Video Understanding Benchmark (Qualcomm Oryon CPU)

method_1a_fixed_1fps.name: Fixed-Interval (1.0 fps uniform)
method_1a_fixed_1fps.redundancy_level: VERY HIGH (captures 4+ nearly identical home screen & idle app frames)
method_1a_fixed_1fps.limitations: Wasteful CPU consumption on static screens; can sample mid-motion blur during swipe.

method_1b_phase1_baseline.name: Phase 1 Heuristic Baseline (10 frames)
method_1b_phase1_baseline.redundancy_level: MODERATE (pairs like 7.5s/8.0s and 2.0s/3.0s contain partial duplicate information)
method_1b_phase1_baseline.limitations: Requires manual tuning of timestamp list; not adaptive to video content.

method_2_ffmpeg_scene_cut.name: Native FFmpeg Scene-Cut Filter (gt(scene,T))
method_2_ffmpeg_scene_cut.limitations: Completely fails on screencasts and UI recordings. At standard thresholds (0.4, 0.2, 0.1), 0 cuts are detected because there are no camera shot changes. At sensitive threshold 0.02, it detects arbitrary animation frames but omits beginning and ending states entirely.

method_3_adaptive_frame_diff.name: Adaptive Perceptual Difference with State Settle & Boundary Anchors

narrative_events_captured.event: Quick Settings shade opened / Airplane Mode active
Sahaaya full Clinical Companion dashboard UI settled

method_3_adaptive_frame_diff.redundancy_level: MINIMAL (1 keyframe per meaningful visual UI state change)
method_3_adaptive_frame_diff.advantages: Captures 100% of functional UI state transitions while reducing vision-encoding time from ~1,087s down to ~362s (3x speedup on CPU).
